title: Gradient descent on the Rosenbrock function
summary: Write the Rosenbrock function and its gradient, and run plain gradient descent that records the loss at every step.

mutants.grad_missing_term: Leaves out the term 400 x (y - x squared) in the derivative with respect to x.
mutants.ascent: Adds the gradient step and does not subtract it, so the loss grows.
mutants.history_misses_start: Does not record the loss of the start point, so the history has one entry too few.
mutants.in_place_start: Updates the start array in place, so the caller's start point changes.
mutants.wrong_y_gradient: Uses 100 and not 200 in the derivative with respect to y.
